=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py:228-237 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: run_check() exempts every scoped repository that has no row in the collector's runs[], not only failed repositories, so a report that leaves out a quiet repository's per-repo subsection still passes with outcome=ok.
  WHY: The approved P2 plan (docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md lines 190-192) exempts only coverage.repositories_failed (or errors[] scope=="runs"), and the model still sees every scoped repository via the analysis context, so this is an undocumented relaxation of the gate. All flaggers rated it MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disputes it as a non-defect: it says repositories with zero runs have no data, failed listings are already exempt, and removing the exemption would hold back every quiet-window report.
- scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py:228-240 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: Repositories that are exempt only because they had no runs are added to exempt_repos, but exempt_source still comes only from _exempt_from_collect_report(), so they are logged with exempt_source=coverage or exempt_source=errors.
  WHY: An operator who reads the WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_CHECK line will not find the repository in coverage.repositories_failed, which is observability drift in a log line the agents.d fragment declares contractual.
- scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py:234-244 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The bounded repo-match lookbehind `(?<![A-Za-z0-9._/-])` includes "/", so a heading such as "### github.com/owner/consumer-app" is not counted as coverage for owner/consumer-app.
  WHY: The checker exits 1 on every attempt (codex_failure_mode="report_structure_invalid"), then handle_log_analysis_codex_failure holds back a compliant report and fails the job. The lookahead alone already prevents the owner/app-two vs owner/app false positive. All flaggers rated it NIT. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same issue only as a hardening suggestion.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1382-1407 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The realpath failure, unsafe path, unsafe staged path and staging failure branches set RUN_LOGS_DIR="" but never set wla_logs_missing="true".
  WHY: When staging fails, the model runs on analysis_context.json only, but no WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_COVERAGE logs=missing line is logged and no data-gap line is added, so the report is published without the P2 data-gap notice.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
(No task gaps reported.)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py:run_check(), lines 228-237 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The checker exempts every scoped repository that has no row in the collector's runs[]. The approved plan exempts only coverage.repositories_failed (docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md lines 190-192). The code's rationale ("no per-repo data for the model to write about") does not hold, because scripts/analyze_workflow_logs.py copies the scope into the analysis context (lines 381-383, line 487) and prompts/mode-workflow-analysis.txt line 99 asks for "one ### subsection per repository".
  WHY: A repository with no runs in the window can have its subsection dropped while the check logs outcome=ok and exits 0, so the approved gate is quietly narrowed. Suggested fix: remove the exemption and its test, or record a plan amendment.
- scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py:run_check(), lines 228-240 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Repositories that are exempt only because they had no runs are listed in exempt_repos with exempt_source=coverage or exempt_source=errors, although neither source lists them.
  WHY: Operators are misled by a log line that the agents.d fragment declares contractual.
- scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py:run_check(), pattern `(?<![A-Za-z0-9._/-])` | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: "/" in the lookbehind rejects host-path headings such as "### github.com/owner/consumer-app".
  WHY: The check exits 1 with report_structure_invalid, then the handler holds back a compliant report and the job fails. Suggested fix: use the lookbehind (?<![A-Za-z0-9._-]).
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:lines 1382-1407 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Four fallback branches set RUN_LOGS_DIR="" without setting wla_logs_missing="true".
  WHY: A staging failure leads to a published report with no data-gap notice. Suggested fix: set the flag and echo the coverage line in each branch (4-8 lines).
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. All four P2 steps are present. The issue title's mention of collect_workflow_logs.py is outside files_touched. The copilot-pull-request-reviewer check failure (custom_instructions_too_large, HTTP 422) is unrelated to the diff.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: the lookbehind fix plus a host-path test (1 + ~5 lines), and wla_logs_missing in the fallback branches (4-8 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py:228-237 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: A repository that is scoped but has no runs in the window is treated as exempt, so per-repository sections can be missing.
  WHY: P2 requires checking each repository in `scope.repositories`. Repositories with no runs are still in scope, so the report can pass without all required sections.
- scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py:234-237 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The bounded repo-match regex lookbehind includes "/", so repositories named as host paths do not match.
  WHY: Headings like `### github.com/owner/consumer-app` are not detected by `(?<![A-Za-z0-9._/-])`, so the repository is reported as missing even though its section exists.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py:run_check(), the `runs = payload.get("runs")` block | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The last run added an exemption for every scoped repository absent from `runs[]`, beyond the plan's failed-repository exemption (`coverage.repositories_failed`, else `errors[]` scope=="runs" excluding the max-runs cap).
  WHY: A scoped repository with zero runs is added to `exempt_lower`, so the model can skip it entirely and the check still returns `outcome=ok`. The exemption is documented in the agents.d and changelog.d fragments but not in the plan file.
- scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py:run_check(), pattern `re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9._/-])" + re.escape(repo.lower()) + r"(?![A-Za-z0-9._-])")` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: "/" in the lookbehind means URL and host-path headings ("### github.com/owner/consumer-app", "### https://github.com/owner/consumer-app") do not match.
  WHY: The checker exits 1 with report_structure_invalid, retries, then calls handle_log_analysis_codex_failure (exit 1). The prefix_sharing_repo_does_not_cover_another test does not cover this false negative.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: drop "/" from the lookbehind and add a `### github.com/owner/consumer-app` test in tests/test_check_workflow_analysis_report.py (1 + ~5 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py:228-237 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The checker exempts every scoped repository absent from `runs[]`, in addition to repositories identified as failed.
  WHY: A scoped repository with no runs is added to `exempt_lower` and its required subsection is not enforced. P2 exempts only `coverage.repositories_failed`, so structurally incomplete reports are accepted.
- scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py:244 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The repository match rejects a repository name preceded by `/`.
  WHY: `### github.com/owner/consumer-app` fails the negative lookbehind, so the checker reports the repository as missing, retries, holds back the report and fails the job.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: NONE. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
(No findings reported.)
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py run_check(), lookbehind `(?<![A-Za-z0-9._/-])` around lines 236-238. Because of "/", "### github.com/owner/repo" headings are never counted, so a compliant report is retried, held back and the job fails. Suggested fix: use `(?<![A-Za-z0-9._-])` and add a test (1 + ~5 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
- Verified non-defect: the no-runs-in-window exemption (scripts/check_workflow_analysis_report.py:228-237) matches the collector, since `runs[]` rows are per run (`scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:2278, 2304-2305, 1259`) and failed listings are already exempt via `errors[]` scope "runs" (2193-2201) and `coverage.repositories_failed` (2202-2207). Removing the exemption would fail every quiet-window report.
- Verified non-defect: the order of handle_log_analysis_codex_failure (.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1329-1332) is correct, because the held report and the data-gap line are written before the handler exits.
- Verified non-defect: the copilot-pull-request-reviewer failure (`custom_instructions_too_large`, HTTP 422) is a third-party service error.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
